General practice: test gentle lifting first. On 300 gsm cotton, a clean damp brush or tissue blotting usually lifts a fresh-looking dark mark without much damage, and it adds no pigment. Avoid scrubbing, which can roughen the surface and make later glazes look patchy. If lifting leaves a pale ghost or a stain, try a very dilute glaze of the same colour over it, and judge both only once fully dry.
